name: time_based_greeting
description: A new customer asks whether the business is currently open. Tests that the AI handles an availability question as part of a greeting and still invites the customer to share what they need.

messages.text: Hi, are you open right now?

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
Reply should acknowledge the greeting and address the open/availability question
Reply should pivot to asking what the customer needs

forbidden_patterns.description: No pricing or quotes in the greeting response

notes: The AI should greet the customer, address whether the business is open (or that it is available via WhatsApp), and then ask what the customer is looking for. It should not fabricate specific operating hours if it does not know them, and should not call any tools.
